findings: 327 successful NPU requests include 13 prewarm and 314 live desktop draws. All have relay acknowledgements; no worker draw rejection or device-loss error is recorded. The previous snapped-crop blocker is no longer observed.

Five 1024x768 frames arrive under the sole indirect display gate. Later frames show wallpaper, icons and the taskbar. Before-Start and after-Start snapshots are identical. No Start-menu appearance is verified, including later frames.

DWM twice binds a 102400-byte vertex buffer while mapped (stride 48, offset zero, valid context). The UMD rejects binding with E_INVALIDARG. Its observer stops on this event; later NPU draws still complete. Microsoft documents unexpected errors from this state-binding callback as critical, so moving mapped-memory validation to the existing draw-time checks is the next correctness investigation.

Live worker draw time totals 139174.960 ms; compilation plus draw time totals 277808 ms. This includes source-build CPU contention during part of the trial and is not an isolated performance or Tahoma comparison.
Both owned drivers unload cleanly and stream configuration is removed. Worker socket closure is normal shutdown. The VM returns to its normal display. Clears remain CPU-side in this installed build.
